title: BGA: A noise-immune neural distillation framework for malicious signature extraction in high-entropy encrypted flows
abstract: arXiv:2608.14126v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: To mitigate attention dilution in high-entropy TLS 1.3 flows, we propose BGA, a noise-immune neural distillation framework for encrypted threat intelligence.The methodology first employs Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) to decouple high-discriminatory control-plane features - specifically industrial setpoints - from stochastic cryptographic noise. To resolve the extreme class imbalance within a corpus of 86,878 flow records, a Wasserstein GAN with Gradient Penalty (WGAN-GP) module, enforcing the 1-Lipschitz constraint, is integrated to synthesize high-fidelity minority samples, elevating the detection recall of rare Malicious State Command Injections(MSCI) attacks by 43.2%. At its core, the BGA architecture integrates Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) for temporal dependency extraction and an Adaptive Gated Multi-Head Attention mechanism. This gated unit functions as a neural filter to dynamically suppress encryption artifacts

translated_title: BGA：一种用于高熵加密流中恶意签名提取的抗噪神经蒸馏框架
translated_abstract: 摘要：为缓解高熵TLS 1.3流中的注意力稀释问题，我们提出了BGA，一种用于加密威胁情报的抗噪神经蒸馏框架。该方法首先采用方差分析（ANOVA）将高判别性的控制平面特征（特别是工业设定点）与随机加密噪声解耦。为解决86,878条流记录语料库中极端的类不平衡问题，集成了一个带有梯度惩罚的Wasserstein GAN（WGAN-GP）模块，该模块强制执行1-Lipschitz约束，以合成高保真少数类样本，将罕见恶意状态命令注入（MSCI）攻击的检测召回率提升了43.2%。在核心部分，BGA架构集成了双向长短期记忆网络（BiLSTM）用于时间依赖性提取，以及自适应门控多头注意力机制。该门控单元作为神经滤波器，动态抑制加密伪影。
tldr: BGA提出了一种结合方差分析解耦、WGAN-GP数据增强和门控注意力过滤的抗噪神经蒸馏框架，有效提升高熵加密流中恶意签名的检测性能。
en_tdlr: BGA proposes a noise-immune neural distillation framework integrating ANOVA decoupling, WGAN-GP augmentation, and gated attention filtering to enhance malicious signature detection in high-entropy encrypted flows.
